Reading the part number

Take J022119-5113311. J022119 is the DEMCO base number for a 2″ Series NE-C valve at 200 psi. The suffix is read left to right: body configuration (5 = lug), body material (1 = ductile iron), stem (1 = 416 stainless steel), disc (3 = Monel) and seat (31 = Buna-N).   • Body rating: ASME Class 150 (285 psi non-shock).

products.descriptionLong:
The Victaulic Series 700 is a grooved-end butterfly valve for carbon steel, ductile iron and plastic piping. It joins the line with Victaulic grooved couplings, so there are no flanges or flange bolts, and it is rated to 200 psi (1400 kPa / 14 bar) maximum working pressure. This page covers the 3″ size, for 3.500″ (88.9 mm) OD pipe. We can supply it with the standard lever handle or with a lockable handle.

Specifications — 3″

Pipe outside diameter3.500″ (88.9 mm)
Maximum working pressure200 psi / 1400 kPa / 14 bar
Flow coefficientCv 180 (Kv 156) fully open
Approximate weight6.8 lb (3.1 kg)

Materials

  • Housing: ductile iron to ASTM A536, Grade 65-45-12.
  • Body: carbon steel, elastomer-lined. Black alkyd enamel coating.
  • Disc: aluminium bronze (C95300 to ASTM B148/B106, or C64200 to ASTM B283) as standard; CF8M stainless steel optional.
  • Upper and lower stem: 416 stainless steel.
  • Handle: cast ductile iron. O-ring in the same compound as the seat.

Seat options

products.descriptionLong:
The Victaulic Vic-300 MasterSeal Series 761 is a grooved-end butterfly valve rated from full vacuum up to 300 psi (2100 kPa / 21 bar), with full working pressure for bi-directional, dead-end service. It connects with Victaulic grooved couplings and has an ISO 5211 mounting flange for direct actuator mounting. This page covers the 4″ size, for 4.500″ (114.3 mm) OD pipe.

Specifications — 4″

Pipe outside diameter4.500″ (114.3 mm)
Working pressureFull vacuum (29.9 in Hg) to 300 psi / 2100 kPa / 21 bar
End to end4.63″ (117.6 mm)
Flow coefficientCv 820 (Kv 707) fully open
Approximate weight9.3 lb (4.2 kg), bare valve
Actuator mountingISO 5211, F07

Materials

  • Body and end face: ductile iron to ASTM A536, Grade 65-45-12, black coated.
  • Disc: electroless-nickel-coated ductile iron (ASTM B733) as standard; CF8M stainless steel or C95500 aluminium bronze optional at this size.
  • Stem: 416 stainless steel (ASTM A582) as standard; 17-4PH optional. Brass stem seal cartridge.
  • Bearings: fibreglass and 316 stainless steel with TFE lining.

Seat options

  • EPDM (green): −30°F to +230°F (−34°C to +110°C). Not for petroleum or steam service.
  • Nitrile (orange): +10°F to +150°F (−12°C to +65°C). Not for hot water above +150°F, hot dry air above +140°F, or steam.
  • Fluoroelastomer (blue): +20°F to +300°F (−7°C to +149°C). Not for steam.

Operators

At 4″ the valve is offered bare with the ISO 5211 flange, with a 10-position handle (infinitely variable, padlockable, with memory stop) or with a gear operator. Not recommended for potable water in stainless steel or copper systems.

Standards

Construction and performance meet or exceed MSS SP-67. Closure/seat leakage rate A to EN 12266-1, EN 1074-1, EN 1074-2 and ISO 5208.

Supply

Supplied from surplus stock through our supply network. Seat grade, operator, quantity, unit condition and any documentation are confirmed on the quotation. Figures on this page are from Victaulic publication 08.20 (Rev W).

faqs.answer: From full vacuum (29.9 in Hg) up to 300 psi (2100 kPa / 21 bar). A one-time system test at 1½ times working pressure is permitted before start-up, at ambient conditions.

faqs.answer: EPDM for water service from −30°F to +230°F (not petroleum or steam). Nitrile for petroleum products and air with oil vapour from +10°F to +150°F. Fluoroelastomer for chemical service from +20°F to +300°F (not steam).

faqs.question: How do I automate it?
faqs.answer: The 4″ valve has an ISO 5211 F07 mounting flange, so a quarter-turn actuator bolts directly on. It is also available with a 10-position handle or a gear operator.
